lines: Reported by The Hacker News: Amazon's threat intelligence team uncovered an AI agent campaign that targets internet-exposed AI apps such as LiteLLM, One API, and Dify to steal stored AI provider keys.

items.headline: New NoisyTCP vulnerability lets attackers crash Linux servers
items.summary: An 11-year-old Linux kernel vulnerability, dubbed NoisyTCP, affects almost all Linux distributions and lets attackers crash systems running Nginx, Apache, and SSH servers with default configurations. [...]
lines: Reported by BleepingComputer: A new vulnerability named NoisyTCP, an 11-year-old Linux kernel flaw, affects almost all Linux distributions.
It lets attackers crash systems running Nginx, Apache, and SSH servers with default configurations.
IT teams running Linux servers with these services in default configurations may want to review their exposure.

In tandem, threat actors are leveraging the power and capabilities of large language models (LLMs)
lines: Reported by The Hacker News: Google revealed that threat actors are using autonomous multi-agent offensive frameworks, such as ARTEX, CAIRN, CyberStrikeAI, and PentAGI, to run multi-stage intrusions.
